Identifier used to identify the client's SOW topic query.
This identifier will be added to all messages representing a
response to the sow_and_subscribe command.

Messages that have fallen out of focus from the subscription
are sent to the client.
Default: false

Option to instruct AMPS that the client would like to receive
the SowKey back.

If true, subscription identifiers will be sent for a matched
message.

A comma-delimited list of SowKeys that identify the messages
to return from the query.

The subscription ID for this command. When provided with a
new subscription, this is the identifier that AMPS will use for
the subscription.
When provided with the replace option, this field specifies
the subscription to replace.
When provided with a pause or resume option, this field
specifies the subscriptions to pause or resume.
For a new subscription, the AMPS clients will generate a
subscription ID if one is not provided.

Return up to the number of messages specified from the SOW
query.
